name: How long does a residential reroofing project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a residential reroofing project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a residential reroofing project typically varies based on the size and complexity of your roof, the chosen materials, and weather conditions. Most standard asphalt shingle reroofing jobs on an average-sized home can be completed within 1 to 3 days. Larger homes, steep pitches, or the use of specialized materials like tile or metal might extend this timeline. Our team aims to minimize disruption and will provide an estimated timeline during the initial consultation, allowing you to prepare for the work and understand the project's phases.
